name: aye
description: Lightweight AI-pair skills for domain boundaries, scope, design, acceptance, review and authorized Git operations.

interface.shortDescription: Domain boundaries, design, acceptance and review for AI pair programming
interface.longDescription: Aye provides focused skills for solo developer and AI pair programming: explore ideas, clarify goals, define domain boundaries and contracts, design meaningful tradeoffs, verify observable results, review changes, track cross-agent review rounds, and perform authorized Git operations. Reuse existing decisions and authorization, and choose workflows by actual risk.
defaultPrompt: Use aye flow to show the workflow map.
Use aye spark to explore whether this idea is worth doing.
Use aye feature to clarify this new feature.
Use aye scope to clarify the goal and impact of this task.
Use aye cross-review to run a multi-agent review round.
